question.id: Apakah saya benar-benar bisa mengedit isi website sendiri?
question.en: Can I really edit the website content on my own?

answer.id: Bisa banget! Kami menyediakan dashboard admin khusus yang sangat mudah digunakan (seperti mengetik di status HP atau mengisi formulir biasa). Anda bisa mengganti teks, harga promo, nomor WhatsApp, hingga foto kapan saja tanpa perlu bantuan koding. Kami juga menyertakan video panduan singkat 15 menit agar Anda langsung mahir.
answer.en: Absolutely! We provide a dedicated admin dashboard that is super easy to use (just like updating your social media status or filling a simple form). You can change text, promo prices, WhatsApp numbers, and photos anytime without touching code. We also include a 15-minute video tutorial so you become proficient immediately.

question.id: Mengapa website ini tidak memakai WordPress?
question.en: Why doesn't this website use WordPress?

answer.id: Website WordPress sering kali lemot karena tumpukan puluhan plugin pihak ketiga, rawan terkena malware jika plugin tidak diperbarui, dan membingungkan untuk diedit bagi orang awam. Kami membangun website Anda dengan teknologi modern (Next.js & Cloud) sehingga website dijamin super ngebut (skor PageSpeed 90+), jauh lebih aman, dan bebas biaya langganan plugin tahunan yang mahal.
answer.en: WordPress websites often become slow due to dozens of third-party plugins, vulnerable to malware if not updated, and confusing to edit for non-tech owners. We build your website using modern cloud tech (Next.js) ensuring lightning-fast load times (PageSpeed 90+), top-tier security, and zero expensive yearly plugin renewals.
